title: Dispatching R&D pipeline for subreport detail rows feature
body: Starting R&D workflow for "subreport detail rows" feature. Greenfield — no prior ADRs or logs on this topic. Dispatching Support-Librarian for artifact context and Support-Researcher for codebase investigation in parallel. The feature involves: 1:N fan-out from NIIN to part numbers and characteristics, with user choice between stacking (cross-product JOIN) and multi-band (UNION ALL) modes. Touches result set shape, query builder, export formatter, and UI layer.

title: PatternEnforcer found 15 gaps in DD-subreport-detail-rows
body: PatternEnforcer found 3 critical gaps and 12 important gaps in DD-subreport-detail-rows. Critical: (1) index.ts barrel exports missing for new types/functions, (2) run-bar.tsx ReportSpec construction doesn't map detailBands, (3) report-graph.ts missing dependency edges for detail band rightIds. Important: _band_id not filtered in grid.tsx/merge-toggles.tsx, 8+ UI components construct partial reportSpec without detailBands, alias-ref-updater.ts doesn't propagate renames to band keyPairs, query-plan.ts catalogCtx missing detailBands, 11 existing test files need fixture updates. Routing back to DDAuthor for amendment.

title: R&D workflow complete — design doc and 4 implementation plans delivered
body: R&D workflow complete for "subreport detail rows" feature. Pipeline: Librarian → Researcher → Ideator → Estimator → Architect → DDAuthor → PatternEnforcer → DDAuthor (amend) → Exec-Planner. Deliverables: 1 design doc (DD-subreport-detail-rows.md, amended with 15 PE gaps), 4 implementation plans (A: MVP 72 steps, B: Multi-Band 26 steps, C: Export 19 steps, D: Polish 29 steps). Total: 146 steps across 30 phases. Key architectural decisions: DetailBandSpec type (modeled on LookupSpec), JS-side stitching (mirrors runTotalsMode), superset-column ResultSet with _band_id, batched WHERE IN queries, new runDetailBandsMode() execution function, buildReportSpecFromState() helper to fix fragmented reportSpec construction pattern.

title: Design created: Column-Type-Aware SQL WHERE Generation
body:
Design document created at artifacts/designs/pending/DD-column-type-aware-where.md.

Research findings:
- AG Grid is display-only (hardcoded agTextColumnFilter) — NOT a viable type source
- SheetJS cell.t metadata is dropped by raw:true import — capturing it adds complexity
- DbTable.samples (3 sample values per column) is available for free

Primary recommendation: Option E — Filter-Value-Driven Heuristic
- Touches only sql-where.ts (~20 lines)
- Fixes both the equality bug AND the comparison-operator-always-REAL bug
- No API change, no schema change, no new types
- looksNumeric() heuristic with leading-zero guard for zip codes

Future enhancement: Hybrid A+E — add sample-based inference at catalog time
- Extends PhysicalColEntry with type field inferred from DbTable.samples
- Combined numericHint = entry.type or looksNumeric(filterValue)

Effort estimate for Option E: SMALL (~2-3 hours)

Spawned Support-PatternEnforcer for DD scope validation.

title: DDAuthor unavailable — creating DD directly
body: The RnD-DDAuthor subagent failed with ProviderModelNotFoundError (likely a model routing config issue). Spawning failed 3 times. I have completed analysis from: Support-Librarian (artifact context), RnD-Architect (implementation analysis with Context7), and RnD-Estimator (effort estimate). I'm synthesizing all three outputs directly into the design document using dd_create.

title: Design document created for column-type-aware WHERE
body: Design document DD-dd-column-type-aware-where.md created. Documents the 6-point decided architecture: (1) Uniform string storage in coerceForSQL, (2) XLSX cell metadata capture at ingestion, (3) DbTable.colTypes extension, (4) Type-aware SQL generation replacing numericHint, (5) User override via context menu, (6) _ROWNO special case. Effort: LARGE (~225 lines across 10 files, 7 implementation phases).
